content.body: turns out, it's convenient to call the SDO for dealing with UTC offset nodes from inside the SDO for dealing with date-time strings. so I may end up doing that editorial work anyway
in writing these SDOs, when should I prefix the section name with "Static Semantics:" vs "Runtime Semantics:" vs nothing?
static because it's at parse-time for the user-supplied string? runtime because it's not at parse-time for the JS program? nothing because it's not JS source code?
